from beidou_shared.config import ConfigProvider
# Verify SAFETY_ONLY fallback
s1 = ConfigProvider().load(environment='UNKNOWN_MODE')
assert s1.environment.value == 'safety_only', f'Expected safety_only, got {s1.environment}'
assert not s1.can_write_trades, 'Expected can_write_trades=False for unknown env'
# Verify Paper mode
s2 = ConfigProvider().load(environment='paper')
assert s2.environment.value == 'paper', f'Expected paper, got {s2.environment}'
assert not s2.can_write_trades, 'Expected can_write_trades=False for paper'
# Verify config hash stable
h1 = s1.config_hash
h2 = ConfigProvider().load(environment='UNKNOWN_MODE').config_hash
assert h1 == h2, 'Config hash not stable'
print('BD-T02 CONFIG VERIFICATION PASSED')
